subject: Joint success timeline & signature readiness — Aurora Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + draft joint success timeline

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Short recap from our discovery and next steps I promised to capture:

Key objectives
- Reduce average query latency for clinician-facing notes generation to <350ms p50
- Keep per-API-call inference cost below $0.02 (target) during pilot
- Ensure PHI never leaves Aurora-managed VPC (private deployment requirement)

Primary success criteria (what we will measure)
- Pilot: 500 monthly active clinician users, 95% availability, 3 regressions or fewer vs baseline on hallucination evals
- Scale: 5k MAU and <0.01% critical errors

Immediate asks / next steps
1) I've attached a first-pass joint success timeline (Aurora_MAP_v1.pdf). Can you confirm owners and if the pilot target (500 MAU) is achievable?
2) Please share the contact for the IT lead who will handle VPC/networking and a point in procurement for contract timing.
3) We’ll follow up with an initial Draft MAP for signature and a short SOW for procurement.

Target close window: late August (aiming to have a signed MAP and SOW by 2026-08-23) — this is our current target but flexible based on your procurement cycle.

I’ll loop in Priyom to author the draft MAP and Marissa on contract/discounting side.

Warmly,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Attachment: Aurora_MAP_v1.pdf (draft timeline, milestones, responsibilities)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft joint success timeline (MAP) — draft v1 attached

Elena / team —

Following Karthik’s recap, please find the draft Mutual Action Plan attached (Aurora_MAP_v1.pdf). TL;DR of milestones and owners below — please reply with edits and any missing dependencies:

Milestones / target dates / owners
- Integration kickoff (API keys + VPC peering): 2026-07-12 — Owner: Samir Patel (Aurora IT) / Priyom Das (Redwood)
- Pilot data ingest & QA: 2026-07-26 — Owner: Aurora Data Ops / Redwood Platform
- Pilot go-live (500 MAU target): 2026-08-16 — Owner: Aurora Product / Redwood CSM
- Sign MAP & SOW: 2026-08-23 — Owner: Aurora Procurement / Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Production scale & handoff: 2026-09-01 — Owner: Aurora Eng / Redwood Infra

Dependencies noted
- VPC peering + KMS access (Aurora IT), procurement review for SOW, and a set of 150 de-identified prompt-eval examples from Aurora clinical team.

Notes:
- Pilot metrics are listed but flexible — if Aurora expects a different pilot size, we can update.
- Marissa is copied for pricing and contract cadence and will prepare a SOW template for procurement.

Next actions
- Elena: confirm Samir’s contact and procurement timeline
- Aurora: confirm pilot metric or suggest alternate
- Redwood: we’ll produce a v2 MAP with any changes and a short SOW template for signatures

Attachment: Aurora_MAP_v1.pdf (outline)
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@aurorahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft joint success timeline (MAP) — draft v1 attached

Thanks, Priyom and Karthik. Quick answers from my side:

- Samir (CC’d) will own the VPC work. He’s available next week for a 30-min tech sync.
- Procurement: I’m the internal sponsor — our procurement lead is Liza Moreno (liza.moreno@aurorahealth.com). They typically need ~3 weeks for SOW review.
- Pilot size: can we bump the pilot to 750 MAU if we keep the same timeframe? That would help validate scale assumptions.

Requested tweak to MAP (pilot metric): change 500 -> 750 MAU and add a success metric for hallucination rate <= 2% on a supervised prompt set.

I attached a short requirements workbook (Aurora_requirements.xlsx) with tech constraints and a procurement note.

Cheers,
Elena Ruiz
Chief Product Officer — Aurora Health
Attachment: Aurora_requirements.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft joint success timeline (MAP) — procurement and SOW cadence

Elena —

Thanks for the clarity. A couple of notes from the Redwood commercial side:

- We can accommodate the pilot increase to 750 MAU. We’ll model cost and share updated run-rate before v2 MAP.
- Discount/commitment: I can offer a pilot discount (10%) and a mid-market tier commitment for the initial 6 months. I’ll include this in the SOW.
- Procurement timing: given your ~3 week review, we should target sharing the SOW by 2026-07-15 to meet the 2026-08-23 signature goal.

Action items for Redwood (Marissa / Monica / Priyom): prepare SOW template, update MAP to v2 with 750 MAU, and create a short DocuSign envelope once Aurora confirms procurement contact.

DocuSign / procurement link (placeholder): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-placeholder

Thanks — I’ll put together the SOW and update the MAP and circulate by 2026-07-10.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@aurorahealth.com>, Liza Moreno <liza.moreno@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 16:33:00 -0700
Subject: Final MAP v2 prepared — confirm signature readiness and target go-live 2026-09-01

Hello all —

Thanks for the fast responses. Based on the inputs I’ve attached the updated MAP (Aurora_MAP_v2.pdf) and a short SOW template (SOW_template.docx). Highlights:

- Pilot adjusted to 750 MAU and hallucination metric <= 2% (per Elena)
- Integration kickoff: 2026-07-12 (Samir / Priyom)
- Pilot go-live: 2026-08-16 (750 MAU)
- Sign by: 2026-08-23 (target) — Redwood to send final DocuSign envelope once Liza confirms procurement routing
- Production handoff & target go-live: 2026-09-01

Before I send the DocuSign envelope, can Aurora confirm:
1) Procurement lead (Liza) is authorized to sign the MAP/SOW or should we route for additional approvals?
2) Any redlines expected in the SOW (Liability, Data Deletion cadence, KMS/HSM language)?

If those are green, I’ll send the envelope today and we can aim to have signatures by 2026-08-23.

Attachment: Aurora_MAP_v2.pdf, SOW_template.docx

—Karthik
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@aurorahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Liza Moreno <liza.moreno@aurorahealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorahealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final MAP v2 prepared — confirm signature readiness and target go-live 2026-09-01

Karthik —

Confirmed. Liza is the procurement lead and is authorized to sign the SOW/MAP. We don’t expect material redlines beyond the usual liability and data deletion language — I’ll flag anything specific by Friday.

Please proceed with the DocuSign envelope. We are aligned on the 2026-09-01 production target and ready to sign.

Elena
Chief Product Officer — Aurora Health
Attachment: signed_MAP_stub.pdf (for internal tracking; final signatures will be via DocuSign)
